description: Use to check whether Bloomy eSIM has plans for a place, or to list all destinations. Returns countries with a dedicated plan: ISO code, localized name, number of plans and the lowest price (from_jpy, from_usd). Many more countries are covered by regional plans (200+ countries and regions in total).

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

query.description: Part of a country name or ISO code to filter by, e.g. "tur" or "TR". Omit to list all.

name: list_destinations
title: List destinations
